text:
maria: Quick kickoff — webinar on Apr 7. Need final X + LinkedIn thread schedule, hero image, and 1-line hook for the registration CTA. :calendar:

sam: I can draft 3 hooks by EOD. who owns hero image?

jess: @maria i'll source a couple of hero variants from creative. do we want portrait + landscape for X cards?

maria: yes both please. X max ratio 16:9 landscape + 4:5 for feed. keep copy short for X thread opener.

leo: For inbound routing — want leads to go to SDR queue + UTM param so we can trace social -> demo. sdr-triage will pick up warm ones.

sdr-triage: Ack. suggest using utm_medium=x_social, utm_campaign=webinar_apr7, utm_content={variant}. we'll auto-tag in the CRM on intake.

maria: perfect. also want A/B on messaging: one bench narrative focused on latency/cost savings, other on reliability/deploy flexibility. Sam will write both.

sam: Drafts below:

---
Hook A (cost/latency): "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency — see how our runtime saves tokens + time."
Hook B (reliability): "Keep your LLM features online at scale — resilient routing, graceful fallbacks, and predictable SLAs."
---

maria: solid. can we shorten Hook A to 1 line for X opener? maybe: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses."

jess: Updated creative ask: hero_v1 (latency theme), hero_v2 (SLA/reliability theme), plus a small explainer GIF showing routing fallback. deliverables by Tue.

leo: scheduling cadence rec:
```
- Apr 1: Teaser post (X + LI) 9am PT
- Apr 3: Thread deep-dive (X) 11am PT
- Apr 6: Reminder + CTA (X + LI) 10am PT
- Apr 7: Live day push (X morning + noon)
```
Make sure timezone tags in scheduler.

maria: love it. can we insert tracking pixel in the registration page? frontend will confirm. @ops-bot can you ping eng?

ops-bot: @frontend-team FYI — add marketing pixel flag for webinar registration page. Ticket: WEB-3421.

sam: Also suggest short follow-up thread after the webinar for highlights + on-demand link. we can repurpose the deep-dive thread into 3 short posts.

jess: For engagement follow-ups — let's prepare 2 quick DM templates for people who comment/RT to drive them to booth/demo signups.

maria: add these to the playbook: 1) comment responders -> invite to on-demand, 2) heavy eng commenters -> SDR outreach, 3) org accounts -> partner outreach.

leo: one more: add fallback post text if hero assets delayed — text-only posts with screenshot + link. keep UTM same.

sam: I'll queue the post text + alt versions in the scheduler. dropping a sample schedule block below for ops to copy into the scheduler: 

```
POST: Apr 3 11:00 PT / Channel: X (org)
Variant: A (cost) / Image: hero_v1.jpg / Copy: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses. Join our webinar Apr 7 -> [link]?utm_campaign=webinar_apr7&utm_medium=x_social&utm_content=A"
POST: Apr 3 11:10 PT / Thread reply 1 / Copy: "Benchmarks: 30% cost reduction on long-tail workloads. Register: [link]"
```

maria: thanks. jess/leo can you confirm asset delivery timeline? if creative misses Tue, we switch to the fallback.

jess: confirm — assets to me by Mon afternoon, final files Tue AM. i'll upload to Figma and g-drive.

leo: routing side: I'll validate the UTM ingest in the CRM on Wed and confirm webhooks.

maria: final asks: 1) creative deliverables, 2) hooks A/B finalized, 3) scheduler populated with posts + UTMs, 4) SDR playbook snippets, 5) follow-up DM templates. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when their piece is done.

sam: ✅

jess: ✅

leo: ✅

sdr-triage: Will post SDR snippets here by Wed.

maria: great — i'll assemble the playbook doc and ping growth for amplification budget. :rocket:
